interpretation: Exploratory source-bound local measurements under substantial unrelated host load. During the 70 in-process scenarios the own fuzz scheduler was paused and compilers were absent. Separate cold consumer cycles ran after historical fuzz workers resumed. These results do not close dedicated-host acceptance or justify a timing threshold. In-process MCP and LSP suites measure core primitives, not their live SDK/handler dispatch.
